1399532.title: Busan Mackerel Festival
1399532.overview: Songdo Beach — Korea's first public beach — hosts this tribute to the national fish since 2008. Busan lands 90 percent of Korea's mackerel, and the festival leans in: bare-hand mackerel catching, surprise auctions, kayak fishing games, paper-boat races, and a big seafood market by the cable car.

2485123.title: Suncheon Food & Art Festival
2485123.overview: Suncheon closes its central boulevard for a festival where local-ingredient street food meets hands-on art: snack stalls, street performances, and street art down the middle of the road.

3552019.title: Beauty Some Suwon 2025
3552019.overview: A K-beauty expo at Suwon Convention Center covering cosmetics, derma and aesthetics, hair and nail, fragrance, inner beauty, and beauty devices — with an AI beauty-tech hall, export fairs, and hands-on citizen programs. Free with pre-registration.

2868776.title: Yeongnam-Honam Traditional Market Expo
2868776.overview: Traditional-market merchants from Busan and Jeonnam — Korea's historically rival southeast and southwest — trade specialties side by side at Busan Citizens Park, with quiz shows, merchant talent stages, and market troupe performances.

3113995.title: Dronebot Festival
3113995.overview: A civil-military drone festival at Ganapri Airfield co-hosted by Gyeonggi Province, Yangju City, and the ROK Ground Operations Command: army dronebot combat-system demos, US Forces Korea equipment displays, drone-robot company exhibitions, competitions, and military culture shows.
3113995.sponsor: Gyeonggi Province · Yangju City · ROK Ground Operations Command

3012116.title: Buyeo Chrysanthemum Festival
3012116.overview: Ten days of chrysanthemums at Gungnamji — Korea's oldest artificial pond, built by Baekje kings — with flower sculptures found only here: the Great Gilt-bronze Incense Burner and Sabi Gate rendered entirely in blooms, across six themed zones. Free, open to 21:00.

3401306.title: Gimpo Marine Corps Culture Festival
3401306.overview: A Marine Corps culture festival at Gimpo's warship park: equipment displays and rides, the Blue Dragon unit departure ceremony, honor guard and military band shows, and army-style food — the ROK Marines up close.
3401306.place: Gimpo Warship Park and Daemyeong Port

2860545.title: Treasure Hunt Festival: Find the Gold Bars!
2860545.overview: Iksan — home of Korea's only jewelry industrial complex — turns a persistent local legend into a festival: two tons of gold bars said to be buried under a colonial-era farm warehouse. AR and RPG technology transform the heritage village into a treasure-hunt stage.

3555835.title: Ansan Science Valley (ASV) Science Festival
3555835.overview: Ansan's brand science festival at Hanyang University ERICA: robots, space engineering, and future-tech exhibitions from the science valley's institutes and companies, fused with performances and hands-on booths that make it all approachable.

2789700.title: Unjeong Lake Park Fireworks Festival
2789700.overview: Paju's resident-founded fireworks festival, in its seventh year: a headline fireworks show over Unjeong Lake with light installations and local performances through the afternoon and evening.

3553159.title: 14th Asian Bird Fair (Seosan)
3553159.overview: Asia's largest bird-watching gathering lands at Seosan Birdland by the Cheonsuman Bay — one of the world's great migratory stopovers. Bird groups and eco-tourism operators from across Asia gather for a weekend of watching, talks, and exhibitions.

3008671.title: National Agricultural Museum Festival: Rest, Stay
3008671.overview: The National Agricultural Museum's harvest-season festival: a silent-disco DJ party in the botanical garden, artist performances, classical concerts, perfume workshops, and treasure hunts — plus its autumn special exhibitions.

3557873.title: Ginkgo Tree Road Street Arts Festival
3557873.overview: Asan's famous ginkgo avenue at golden peak becomes a circus carnival: non-verbal street performances — circus, mime, juggling, percussion — with kids' circus workshops and local produce markets under the yellow canopy.

1806376.title: Gangdong Book Festival
1806376.overview: The 16th reading festival of Gangdong, marking the opening of the new Gangdong Central Library under the theme 'THE LIBRARY: 도서관+': announcer-hosted lectures and piano-accompanied readings, publisher booths, and library goods.
1806376.place: Gangdong Central Library and Dunchon Park

3026189.title: Real Treasure Festival
3026189.overview: A smartphone-based spy adventure at the old Gyeonggi provincial office: participants become secret agents solving missions through the historic building — CODENAME: H, spy hunter games, a mystery theme park, and an alien-capture operation. Free with reservation.

3399435.title: Anseong Fitting Festival: Tok-Tok Sweet
3399435.overview: The 27th arts festival of Anseong's artist federation at the Yongseol lake stage: K-pop cover dance, kids' dance time, magic shows, musical gala, busking, an art market, and bounce zones — a generation-bridging family day out.

3383832.title: Chemistreet Gangnam Station Festival
3383832.overview: A commercial-district festival around Gangnam Station under Seoul's local-brand program: music, wellness, brand pop-ups, K-culture, and food across themed tracks (MIDNIGHT, LIFE, CHEMI, TASTE) running day into night, with district coupons and showcases.

2872215.title: Goheung Citron Festival
2872215.overview: Korea's biggest yuja (citron) growing region celebrates its golden harvest — twice named Jeonnam's representative festival. Under the slogan 'the scent of people, citron heaven', the citron-field healing garden glows with night lighting while tastings and markets run all day.

3460731.title: Gwangju Women's Film Festival
3460731.overview: An annual film festival amplifying women filmmakers: screenings with workshops, seminars, and panel talks that push both craft conversation and gender equality in Korean cinema.

1080734.title: Yeongdo Bridge Festival
1080734.overview: A festival celebrating Busan's beloved bascule bridge and the island district it connects: a 43-meter runway stage hosts the Yeongdo Dynamic Dancing Festival, with exhibitions and experiences linking the island's history, sea, and people.

1855589.title: 19th Jeonbuk Youth Film Festival
1855589.overview: A film festival of works made by teenagers — national and Jeonbuk sections with screenings, awards, and director talks under the slogan 'awkward is okay', in Jeonju's cinema district.

3563389.title: Jukbyeon Port Seafood Festival
3563389.overview: Uljin's harbor festival at Jukbyeon Port: bare-hand fish catching, seafood butchering shows, mulhoe performances, on-the-spot auctions, and a fishing-boat parade against the East Sea, with trot stars at the opening concert.

3344495.title: Hadong Byeolmat (Star Taste) Festival
3344495.overview: A food festival rediscovering Hadong's own flavors: the Seomjin River corbicula soup made famous by K-dramas, the clear chicken harvest soup farmers ate at threshing time, and a hundred local tastes with riverside stages.

3560787.title: Yanggang Island Arts Festival
3560787.overview: Yangpyeong's brand arts festival by the river, this year centered on gugak — traditional Korean music meeting contemporary staging — with performances, exhibitions, and hands-on programs in the county's riverside parkland.

2874909.title: Yeosu Night Sea Fireworks Festival
2874909.overview: Fireworks over the water that inspired Korea's most famous night-sea ballad: music-synchronized shows above Jangundo Island off Yi Sun-sin Square, with performances along the old harbor. Free — arrive early; the waterfront fills fast.
2874909.place: Yi Sun-sin Square and harbor waters

3557782.title: Open Port Dog Library
3557782.overview: A book-and-dog festival on Incheon's 1883 Open Port Plaza: reading lounges where dogs are welcome, a free-run and agility course, walking-training and grooming classes, pet tarot and crafts, and a local pet-goods market.

3553639.title: Dongmyeong Coffee Walk
3553639.overview: Gwangju's cafe-quarter festival in Dongmyeong-dong: tasting passports with flavor voting ('Just Award'), a cafe-tour-plus-exhibition walk, local makers' market, ateliers, and lounge stages across the neighborhood by the Asia Culture Center.

3562944.title: Changwon Industrial Complex Culture Festival
3562944.overview: A culture festival for the workers and neighbors of Changwon's industrial complex: opening performances, concerts, an exhibition of the complex's transformation, content booths, and a workers' singing contest — industry read through culture.
3562944.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism · Changwon City

2856063.title: Incheon Airport Sky Festival
2856063.overview: The world's only airport mega-festival, running since 2004 and rebranded for its 20th edition at the Inspire Resort: two days of K-pop headliners (past lineups include Highlight, Crush, Heize, Sung Si-kyung) plus K-drama and craft culture zones. Free.

3553728.title: Gyeonggi Kimchi Festa
3553728.overview: A kimchi expo ahead of kimjang season: a national kimchi competition, make-your-own workshops, a communal kimjang for sharing, ingredient markets, and master-artisan kimchi exhibitions at Suwon Convention Center.

2384776.title: Hangang & Mountains Trekking (2nd)
2384776.overview: Seoul's citizen trekking series pairing river and mountain courses with themed rounds — family, couples, singles, dog-walking, fashion — up to 600 walkers per round with course events along the way.

2622167.title: Gyeongbuk Apple Fair (Seoul)
2622167.overview: Fourteen apple-growing counties of Gyeongbuk bring the new harvest to Seoul Plaza: premium apple exhibitions, sculpture displays, tastings of every major variety, and direct sales at grower prices for three days.

3572025.title: Donggwol Night Tour
3572025.overview: A night program through Changgyeonggung and the UNESCO-listed Changdeokgung rear garden — together once called Donggwol, the East Palace: an immersive 60-minute tour guided by a court painter character, then 40 minutes free in the moonlit Secret Garden. Four sessions nightly, 50 people each.

3301415.title: Muan YD Festival
3301415.overview: A youth festival at Namak Central Park in Muan — 'where my dream comes true' — positioning the provincial-capital town as a youth culture hub with stages, programs, and community events.

2769990.title: Korea Sool Grand Festival
2769990.overview: Korea's largest traditional-liquor festival at the aT Center: hundreds of brewers from every province pouring makgeolli, yakju, and distilled spirits for tasting and direct purchase, with pairing programs and events. Entry 10,000 won.
2769990.sponsor: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs

3021762.title: Autumn, to Myeongdong
3021762.overview: A neighborhood autumn event at the 'Jaemiro' plaza by Myeongdong Station: performances, a toy flea market whose proceeds partly fund toys for children in need, and prize events along Seoul's comic street.
3021762.place: Jaemiro Sangsang Plaza, Myeongdong Station exit 3

3410210.title: Starlight Tavern: Soyang
3410210.overview: A night festival in the hanok village of Soyang, Wanju: traditional-house taverns serving local food and black-persimmon makgeolli, talks, live music, and the Starlight K-Contest among the wooden courtyards of Oseong Hanok Village.
3410210.place: Oseong Hanok Village and Soyang Gotaek

3395188.title: Sunchang Korea Tteokbokki Festa
3395188.overview: K-food's favorite street dish meets Korea's fermentation capital: tteokbokki recipes built on Sunchang's famous gochujang, with tastings, exhibitions, photo zones, and family programs in the home of traditional pastes.

3563444.title: Bangbae Cafe Alley Festa
3563444.overview: A revival festival for Bangbae's cafe alley — the original hangout street of 1980s Seoul youth culture — under the slogan 'the alley itself is a cafe': merchant-led programs, performances, and markets reconnecting generations to the district.

3567099.title: Hongseong Baekban Festa
3567099.overview: A home-style-table festival at Gwangcheon Culture Market — famous for gim and jeotgal — serving local-ingredient baekban spreads and global gimbap, with seaweed-roasting, cooking classes, and market events under the theme 'a full Gwangcheon table'.

2623638.title: Hologram Expo: HOLO WAVE
2623638.overview: Jeonbuk's hologram-industry expo at Wonkwang University: graphic-art displays, technology and product exhibitions, hands-on hologram experiences, a future-tech forum on AI and XR, and hologram performances. Free.

3416371.title: Early Early Christmas
3416371.overview: Hwasun's head start on the holidays: a Christmas market and marching-band parade, night market, classic carousel, and family programs filling Namsan Park before December even arrives.

629742.title: 46th Seoul Dance Festival
629742.overview: Korea's flagship contemporary dance festival at the Arko Arts Theater, this year exploring the 'omnivore' era — connection over fusion, individuality intact — through premieres and competition stages by the national dance association.

2515174.title: Korea AI Education Festival
2515174.overview: A national AI-education festival at KINTEX running since 2015: exhibitions, hands-on zones, and lectures that make AI learning approachable for students, teachers, and families. Free.
2515174.sponsor: Ministry of Science and ICT · Ministry of Education

3554794.title: Korea Kimjang Grand Festival
3554794.overview: A national celebration of kimjang — Korea's UNESCO-listed communal kimchi-making culture — at the aT Center: master-kimchi sales halls, ingredient markets, discounts, performances, and hands-on booths as the winter kimchi season opens.

3567075.title: Sangsang Platform Sool Sool Festa
3567075.overview: A traditional-liquor festival in Incheon's open-port warehouse venue: 32 breweries pouring Korean sool, makgeolli-brewing and cocktail classes, soap-making from brewing lees, busking and DJ parties, plus a camping pop-up and local-food market.

2853386.title: Dan-Dan-Dan Festival
2853386.overview: Gangneung's winter tradition festival at the Danoje education hall — 'our one and only finest festival': gugak-crossover headliners, a children's traditional performance day, regional troupes, and the Yeongsanhong concert with pansori and street-dance stars.

3437916.title: Christmas Village Busan
3437916.overview: A month-long Santa village across the grounds of the Busan Cinema Center: some 150 local and popular brands, world street food and Christmas menus, gift and lifestyle shops, and pop-ups under the world's largest cantilever roof — Korea's biggest Christmas market.

3432658.title: Hampyeong Winter Light Festival
3432658.overview: Hampyeong keeps its chrysanthemum-festival sculptures lit through winter: large light installations, media-art projections, and evening programs across the Expo Park and town streets. Free, evenings.
3432658.place: Hampyeong Expo Park and town center

3367339.title: K-Rice Festa: Our Rice, Our Sool

3422647.title: Game Playground Pop-up
3422647.overview: Six Busan game studios open their titles for public play in a pop-up at Gwangalli: story-and-art booths with playable zones, stamp tours with prizes, and special game events — indie Korean gaming made approachable.

3569496.title: Kimjang Together at Jeolla Gamyeong
3569496.overview: The old provincial seat of Jeonju revives the communal kimjang: visitors make kimchi together — later delivered to neighbors in need — with performances and traditional games recreating the warmth of village kimchi season.

3396705.title: Ulsan Culture Expo
3396705.overview: A culture expo tracing Ulsan's 6,000-year creative lineage — from the newly UNESCO-listed Bangucheon petroglyphs, called the origin of Korean art, to today's citizen arts scene — with participatory programs by local artists at UECO.

2915307.title: Yuseong Hot Springs Christmas Festival
2915307.overview: Daejeon's hot-spring district opens the holidays with a tree-lighting and drone light show, 30 market and experience booths, a vin-chaud lounge, bubble and acoustic stages, instant-photo booths, and a carousel in Yurim Park.
